text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One week from Monday 22 June 2026, UTC; the aggregate is rung 4's (25% Burwell solar, 75% Lakeside battery by 99th- percentile output, 100 MW in total, with no demand-like part; rung 7c adds one), with the regional CAMS sky. A8 gives the fitted battery the true battery's power and energy capacity; A9 gives it the true power and 2 hours of energy. The fit used the whole year in windows of about 4 weeks.'
text.tspan: One week from Monday 22 June 2026, UTC; the aggregate is rung 4's (25% Burwell solar, 75% Lakeside battery by 99th-
percentile output, 100 MW in total, with no demand-like part; rung 7c adds one), with the regional CAMS sky. A8
gives the fitted battery the true battery's power and energy capacity; A9 gives it the true power and 2 hours of
energy. The fit used the whole year in windows of about 4 weeks.
